description: This file is a minified/concatenated JavaScript library implementing web components polyfills, including URL parsing, WeakMap, MutationObserver, HTMLTemplateElement, and performance/requestAnimationFrame polyfills, with license and version info.

classes.name: HTMLTemplateElement
classes.description: Polyfill for HTMLTemplateElement, enabling template content and innerHTML property.

classes.name: WeakMap
classes.description: Polyfill for WeakMap if not natively supported.

classes.name: JsMutationObserver
classes.description: Polyfill for MutationObserver if not natively supported.

classes.name: MutationRecord
classes.description: Represents a mutation record for MutationObserver.

methods.name: HTMLTemplateElement.decorate
methods.description: Decorates a template element to support content and innerHTML.

methods.name: HTMLTemplateElement.bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes all template elements in a document.

methods.name: WeakMap.prototype.set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the WeakMap.

methods.name: WeakMap.prototype.get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key from the WeakMap.

methods.name: WeakMap.prototype.delete
methods.description: Deletes a key from the WeakMap.

methods.name: WeakMap.prototype.has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the WeakMap.

methods.name: JsMutationObserver.prototype.observe
methods.description: Starts observing a target node for mutations.

methods.name: JsMutationObserver.prototype.takeRecords
methods.description: Returns a list of mutation records.
